strategyReview: The proven edges remain Polymarket YES overpricing (panel NO cuts and one-touch NO premium fade) and weekend Hyperliquid funding reversion long, which is live-eligible with 367/525 wins and strong shadow support. The main failures are directional re-authorings of contract trades as spot-move bets (especially GOLD one-touch NO), static funding thresholds that do not require reversion to have started, and HYPE/listed-IV momentum confirmation setups that enter late and lose more often than their base rates.

failureClusters.theme: Contract premium trades scored as spot-direction bets
failureClusters.evidence: GOLD one-touch NO family shows 30% scorable win rate and 7 unscorable tests; contract rows like NO 0.375 -> 0.400 gained +6.7%, while the spot-decline prediction failed.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author one-touch and panel NO trades as contract P&L theses with direction neutral, not spot moves.

failureClusters.theme: Static funding-extreme triggers without reversion confirmation
failureClusters.evidence: CBRS 13/29 (45%), AAPL 10/21 (48%), and MU 5/16 (31%); many losers show funding staying pinned or falling further rather than normalizing.
failureClusters.recommendation: Add a turning/confirmation condition such as 24h change already positive while funding is still deeply negative.

failureClusters.evidence: Cross-asset BTC long using HYPE confirmation is 9/25 (36%), with losses like -3.47% and +0.70% despite trend screens.
failureClusters.recommendation: Treat HYPE participation as a lagging risk indicator, not an independent BTC continuation signal; kill or refactor the family.

failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 3/22 (-2.85% avg), PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 1/17 (-6.00% avg).
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep these in shadow and do not promote; if retained, require contract-level premium fade rather than directional spot assumptions.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-534: re-author the GOLD one-touch high-edge signal as a contract premium fade instead of a spot-decline prediction. The prior variant was unscorable/understated because the trade is long NO and profits from YES premium compression, not from a 2% spot fall.
newHypotheses.prediction: Buying NO / selling YES on GOLD above-strike one-touch contracts is profitable over 7 days as YES premium compresses toward model fair value

hypothesisReviews.observation: The GOLD one-touch NO family is not trading a spot-decline thesis. It scored 6/20 and burned 7 unscorable tests because the prediction demanded a >2% GOLD decline, while the contract rows show the actual edge is premium compression on NO contracts.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large underlying-cap edge on GOLD upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: CBRS funding below -10 too often stayed pinned or fell further; several losses show funding moving from -4.3 to -33.8 or -6.2 to -33.6 instead of normalizing. A static threshold is not a normalization trigger.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A standalone CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes within 2 days and forces a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: AAPL losses concentrated in flat or already-positive funding readings such as 5.5% and 11.2%; the signal needs actual extreme negative funding and evidence the reversion has begun.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AAPL funding below -10% on any day reliably normalizes and leads to a >2% spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: MU failures were dominated by flat funding readings around 5.5% and one rally from +29.1% to +3.4%; the condition did not isolate genuine negative funding stress or reversion.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single MU funding reading below -10% reliably predicts normalization and a >2% MU spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Cross-asset BTC long with HYPE confirmation is 9/25 (36%) despite several historically strong-looking wins; the losses show BTC pulled back even when HYPE looked risk-on, consistent with HYPE being an echo of the same move rather than an independent confirmation.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above its 24h SMA with stable OI is an independent confirmation of durable BTC upside rather than late-stage FOMO/overextension.

hypothesisReviews.observation: BTC listed-IV momentum confirmation is 4/18 (22%) and the realized outcomes show the IV signal confirmed volatility or already-priced momentum but did not produce reliable further spot gains in the tested direction.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: BTC spot momentum confirmed by rising listed option IV reliably leads to further >2% gains within 3-7 days.

journalEntry: Tonight's main lesson is that one-touch and panel NO edges must be stated as contract P&L theses, not spot-direction predictions. The GOLD one-touch family was mis-measured by exactly this error. Static funding thresholds for CBRS/AAPL/MU are also failing because they ignore whether normalization has actually begun; refinements now require deeply negative funding with a positive 24h change. The outcome-panel NO edge remains the strongest research input, so I kept most new hypothesis spend on sharpening YES-overpricing in mid-priced, near-dated, tight/liquid contracts. No risk parameters were changed because recent realized loss clusters are better addressed by signal gating and re-authoring than by stop/target tuning.
